blockchain-integracion-bd.subtitle: MySQL and BigchainDB Integration with REST API and Tendermint
blockchain-integracion-bd.description: REST API designed to integrate a MySQL relational database with BigchainDB, providing fast and secure storage combined with immutability and traceability.

api.title: REST API
api.subtitle: Node.js + Express
api.f1: Endpoints to create and validate records
api.f3: Encryption and decryption of sensitive data

step1.title: Data Insertion
step1.f1: Client makes a POST request to the REST API
step1.f2: Data is validated and stored in MySQL
step1.f3: A hash is generated and registered in BigchainDB
step1.f4: The transaction ID is updated in MySQL

step2.title: Data Validation
step2.desc: Data in MySQL is compared with the hash registered in BigchainDB to guarantee integrity.

step3.title: Encryption and Decryption
step3.desc: Data is encrypted before being stored. Only authorized users can decrypt it. Immutable records in BigchainDB.

endpoints.title: Main Endpoints
endpoints.e1_desc: Creates a record in MySQL and a transaction in BigchainDB. Returns the hash.
endpoints.e2_desc: Validates the integrity of a MySQL record by comparing it against BigchainDB.
endpoints.e3_desc: Retrieves and decrypts data associated with a specific transaction.

cases.title: Use Cases
cases.intro: This project is ideal for applications where data integrity and authenticity are essential. Some use cases include:

c1.title: Supply Chain
c1.desc: Complete and immutable traceability of products from origin to final consumer.

c2.title: Audits
c2.desc: Immutable record of transactions and changes for regulatory compliance and audits.

c3.title: Academic Records
c3.desc: Secure certification and verification of degrees and academic credentials.

c4.title: Smart Contracts
c4.desc: Record of agreements and contracts with guarantee of immutability and traceability.

c5.title: Medical Records
c5.desc: Secure and immutable storage of medical records and treatments.

c6.title: Certifications
c6.desc: Issuance and verification of digital certificates with guarantee of authenticity.

Expert in orchestrating complex cloud environments with a focus on high availability, scalability, and zero-downtime deployments. Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and modern GitOps workflows (Pipelines). Cloud security and disaster recovery strategies.
